articles.title: Bali's petrol queues offer a reality check for India's holidaymakers
articles.description: Susheel Jain nearly missed his flight from Bali due to fuel shortages impacting transport around the island. The local fuel crisis, driven by delayed supplies and high demand, has caused panic buying and long queues. Authorities have taken steps to stabilize the situation, including increased deliveries and revised purchase limits. Despite the crisis, daily tourist arrivals remain steady, and tourism is crucial to Bali's economy.
